title: Responding to Findings and Exiting Increased Monitoring
summary: Brings the programme together by examining how to respond to evaluation findings, agree and deliver an action plan under increased monitoring, and sustain effectiveness after exit.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Brings the programme together by examining how to respond to evaluation findings, agree and deliver an action plan under increased monitoring, and sustain effectiveness after exit.
Learning Objectives: Prioritise recommended actions and allocate ownership and resources
Design and deliver an action plan that meets increased monitoring deadlines
Sustain reforms and prepare for follow-up assessments
Syllabus: Prioritising recommended actions by impact and feasibility
Increased monitoring: action plans, reporting and on-site verification
Political leadership, resourcing and communication with industry
Workshop: a national action plan to address deficiencies
Intended Audience: Officials in finance, justice and interior ministries who lead national AML/CFT policy and coordination
FIU directors and analysts, financial investigators, prosecutors and asset recovery officials
Members and secretariats of national AML/CFT coordination committees and mutual evaluation teams
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of AML/CFT policy, financial intelligence or law enforcement is helpful. No prior involvement in a mutual evaluation is required.
Core Reading: FATF (2012, updated), International Standards on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation: The FATF Recommendations
FATF (2013, updated), Methodology for Assessing Technical Compliance with the FATF Recommendations and the Effectiveness of AML/CFT Systems
FATF (2013), National Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment
FATF (2023), Guidance on Beneficial Ownership of Legal Persons
